title: SYNTH Benchmark
summary: A reproducible benchmark comparing eight tabular synthetic-data generators across 15 datasets on utility, fidelity, and privacy, producing publication-ready statistics and figures. Four of its eight generators (CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE, GaussianCopula) plus quality/diagnostic scoring are run directly through the SDV single-table API.
